description: Apple announces Memory Integrity Enforcement with the iPhone 17 and iPhone Air, naming the A19 and A19 Pro chips.
usbliter8 BootROM exploit for A12 and A13 devices is publicised (reported by secondary outlets and a national CERT).
Dopamine 3.0 released; secondary coverage quotes a support table of iOS 15.0 to 17.3.1 for A8 to A17 and M1 to M2, and iOS 26.0 to 26.0.1 for A12 and A13.
device_scope: A8 to A17 and M1 to M2 (as quoted)
firmware_scope: iOS 15.0 to 17.3.1 (as quoted); A12 and A13 to 26.0.1

description: iOS 27.0 released (build 24A437 per the third-party index).
device_scope: iPhone 15 Pro Max (iPhone16,2) and other iPhones

description: iOS 27.0.1 released (build 24A446). Apple's security releases index lists no published CVE entries for this build.
Calif.io reportedly demonstrates an untethered iOS 27.0.1 jailbreak on an iPhone 18 Pro at Hexacon 2026 in Paris.
Apple's iOS 27 security notes are updated with CVE entries credited to Calif.io researchers, two of them jointly with Claude and Anthropic Research.
firmware_scope: iOS 27 (fixed-in release per CVE not confirmed)

description: Apple's index lists iOS 27.1 for iPhone Duo with no published CVE entries.
iOS 27.2 released (build 24B119 per the third-party index). Secondary press reports 163 fixed vulnerabilities; Apple's 27.2 advisory was not located.
device_scope: iPhone 15 Pro Max (iPhone16,2) per the index

description: A community reference states that iOS 27.0.1 was still signed on 2026-11-02. This is not independently verified and conflicts with the third-party index checked on 2026-11-11.
Dopamine 3.0.13 published. Release notes describe a posix_spawn hook fix and a SpringBoard snapshot change. They do not state iOS 27 support.
Press reports that Apple responded to MIE-bypass claims with an iOS update. Details were not verified.
Reported plan for a kernel read/write exploit and write-up from a Calif.io-linked researcher within about a week. Coverage conflicts; no primary announcement was located.
Press coverage through about 2026-11-06 reports that Apple fixed most flaws in iOS 27.2 and that no public tool is planned.
iOS 27.2.1 released (build 24B156 per the third-party index and the Wikipedia infobox).
device_scope: iPhone 15 Pro Max (iPhone16,2) per the index

description: Press reports Apple stopped signing iOS 26.6.2 after iOS 27 shipped. Used as a pattern example for how older builds lose signing.
Tracker snapshot. The third-party index lists iOS 27.0.1 as not signed. A community reference reports the opposite for 2026-11-02, so the status is unresolved.
